title: What is the percentage difference of student badges given during 2010 and 2
question:
What is the percentage difference of student badges given during 2010 and 2011?
Benchmark knowledge evidence: student badges refers to badge's name = 'Student'; during 2010 refers to Year(Date) = 2010; during 2011 refers to Year(Date) = 2011; percentage difference = Subtract (Divide(Count(Name where Year(Date) = 2010), Count (Name)) *100, Divide(Count(Name where Year(Date) = 2011), Count(Name)) * 100)

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT
  (
    (
      SELECT COUNT(*)
      FROM badges
      WHERE strftime('%Y', XCL_004) = '2010'
    ) -
    (
      SELECT COUNT(*)
      FROM badges
      WHERE strftime('%Y', XCL_004) = '2011'
    )
  ) * 100.0 /
  (
    SELECT COUNT(*)
    FROM badges
    WHERE strftime('%Y', XCL_004) = '2010'
  ) AS percentage_difference

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT
  (CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', XCL_004)='2010' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL)*100.0/COUNT(*)) -
  (CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', XCL_004)='2011' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL)*100.0/COUNT(*))
FROM badges
WHERE XCL_003='Student';
